mapper.select: select CT.ID, CT.USER_ID, CT.PRODUCT_ID, CT.QUANTITY, CT.CREATE_TIME, CT.UPDATE_TIME, PR.NAME as PRODUCT_NAME, PR.PRICE, PR.IMAGE_URL, PR.STOCK, PR.STATUS from SHOP_CART CT left join SHOP_PRODUCT PR on PR.ID = CT.PRODUCT_ID where CT.USER_ID = #{userId} order by CT.CREATE_TIME asc
mapper.insert: insert into SHOP_CART (ID, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QUANTITY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
